summary: Review-required audit trail for the live temporary-file cleanup card. The app already ships this file-backed cleanup action and the repo cleanup docs describe the same temp directories, but the card has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Clear Temporary Files
setting.casual_explanation: This deletes files from the user temp folder and the Windows temp folder.
setting.why_people_change_it: People clear temporary files when they want to reclaim disk space from leftover installer and application temp files.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Clearing temp files can reclaim space, but files currently in use will be skipped and some apps may rebuild temp content later.
setting.professional_notes: The current app deletes Path.GetTempPath() and %WINDIR%\Temp through FileCleanupTweak. Repo cleanup docs identify the same temporary-file cleanup surface.

allowed_values.label: No cleanup action
allowed_values.meaning: Temporary files remain until the operator or Windows removes them.

allowed_values.label: Clear temporary files
allowed_values.meaning: Deletes files under the user temp and Windows temp directories, skipping files in use.

targets.notes: This is a one-shot cleanup action rather than a persistent temp-file policy setting.
